question: If the radius of a sphere is halved, then the new volume will become ______ the original volume.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **volume** of a sphere is proportional to the **cube** of its **radius** (V ∝ r³).

If the radius becomes **1/2** of its original value, the volume change ratio = (1/2)³.

Calculation: (1/2) × (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/8.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/8 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Original radius = r, New radius = r/2

**Formula Used:** Volume of a Sphere (V) = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0054b41725528f2b0fc7d835bcd8ead909eab64f995672f9e306bbe86fd1bd60.png] 

⇒ Original Volume (V₁) = (4/3) × π × r³

⇒ New Volume (V₂) = (4/3) × π × (r/2)³

⇒ V₂ = (4/3) × π × (r³ / 8)

⇒ V₂ = (1/8) × [(4/3) × π × r³]

⇒ V₂ = (1/8) × V₁

**∴ The correct answer is 1/8 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

The surface area is given by 4πr². If the radius is halved, the surface area becomes (1/2)² = 1/4 of the original.

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is half of a sphere, and its volume is given by (2/3)πr³.

Ratio of Volumes

For any similar 3D shapes, the ratio of their volumes is the cube of the ratio of their corresponding linear dimensions (Side₁/Side₂)³.</p
